name: PT Cerestar Indonesia Tbk
summary: Operating in Indonesia, PT Cerestar Indonesia Tbk is primarily involved in the production, refinement, and commercialization of wheat flour. Its product offerings encompass wheat flour, destined for use in food and bakery ingredients, alongside bran and pollard, which are key components for animal feed. These products are distributed under established brands like Falcon, Seagull, Dragonfly, Bakerstar, and Starfish. PT Cerestar Indonesia Tbk functions as a controlled entity under the umbrella of PT Sunterra Indonesia.
